source_title: Game Theory #14: The Law of Proximity
summary: This Game Theory lecture supplies the named law of proximity already used by the public Proximity Games page, while adding forecast-family pressure around Iran escalation, leader-killing off-ramps, AI/finance bailout rivalry, domestic election control, nationalist theocracy, and forced spiritual reset.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The public read already links the law-of-proximity marks to the Proximity Games anchor: actors play many games at once, and the nearest visible game often governs action.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Proximity Games owns this as player/payoff structure: apparent interstate war becomes readable as nearer party, faction, intelligence, religious, or domestic succession games.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The public read already links the anti-master-plan mark around Jewish factional conflict to the Secret Society guardrail anchor.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Secret Society owns the guardrail because Jiang rejects a unified conspiracy reading and instead stresses permanent internal division, faction, and creative infighting.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public as the page's definition spine: use this source whenever a foreign war, intelligence leak, party strategy, city split, or religious faction becomes an instrument for the actor's nearer game.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Proximity Games owns the nearest-game logic. Strategy and Chokepoint own material war execution; Mass Society owns draft/election-control machinery; Eschatology owns sacred role-script.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the opening Iran-war pressure as no-exit evidence only if Chokepoint later enters replacement/compression: energy infrastructure, GCC exposure, cheap-energy fragility, leader-killing, and mission creep make the war lose its settlement path.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Chokepoint is already at replacement/compression pressure, so this should not become another ordinary append or a standalone Iran War page.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source as a dangerous proximity/escalation example when eschatology makes damage read as evidence: Tel Aviv's destruction can confirm Jerusalem's messianic frame, and Iran can radicalize through both Shia eschatology and Persian exceptionalism.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology owns sacred meaning and purification logic. Proximity Games owns why those frames become nearer domestic games; Prediction owns dated future claims.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Route private-credit bailout moral hazard and circular AI financing to Power and AI Control boundary work: Jiang treats both finance and AI bubbles as bailout-seeking games where value is manufactured through circular claims and political rescue expectations.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power owns money and value alchemy. AI Control owns interface/command and state absorption by AI only when the machine surface is primary; Platform Infrastructure owns data-center and technical-rail material when evidenced.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source as the March 19 proximity-law layer in the Iran/emergency forecast family: war can become a domestic election tool, draft/voter-ID pressure appears as factional payoff, AI and private credit expect bailout, and Jiang points toward five-to-ten-year depression and splintering.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns dated comparison and ledger readiness. Mass Society owns administrative draft/election-control machinery; Proximity Games owns factional payoff.

new_lens_seeds.title: Leader As Off-Ramp
new_lens_seeds.mechanism: A leader can be both military target and settlement channel; decapitation may remove the actor able to authorize a treaty, reward more extreme successors, and make war less controllable.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The gang analogy and Larajani example turn leader-killing into a general strategy test that could recur in Iran, proxy-war, assassination, and regime-change sources.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Keep this as Chokepoint/Strategy evidence for now; do not create a standalone decapitation-strike page from one lecture.

new_lens_seeds.title: Animal Soul And Divine Soul Politics
new_lens_seeds.mechanism: A nation or person can split between material appetite and sacred purification, so destruction of the material center can be read as purification rather than loss.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The Tel Aviv/Jerusalem split and final modern-soul diagnosis may connect Eschatology, Human Heart, Free Will, and Dead World if the pattern recurs beyond this lecture.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Eschatology and Human Heart can absorb this until multiple dated sources prove a distinct public mechanism.

chronology_notes.note: This 2026-03-19 lecture is the named definition source for the law of proximity and should remain the origin layer for the public Proximity Games anchor.

The source sits between earlier March Iran-war pressure and later March/April emergency-power forecasts; it adds the domestic-faction explanation for why an external war could become a U.S. election, draft, or bailout game.
Jiang explicitly points from this lecture toward five-to-ten-year world change, economic depression, and splintering; those claims require comparison before ledger promotion.
